profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Ticketmaster / Live Nation Entertainment
profile.summary:
Over 4+ years of work experience in system design and development on various technologies, languages and frameworks.
An excellent problem solver, able to quickly grasp complex systems and identify opportunities for improvements and resolution of critical issues.
Highly efficient to produce comprehensive software documentation – Requirement/Design/Test Specification, creating builds and release of the software products and achieving project milestones on time. 
Designed and implemented applications following Agile Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) model, Object Oriented Programming (OOP) techniques and various design patterns.
Master of Information Technology and Management degree from Illinois Institute of Technology.
Extensive experience in Agile development, methodology, working with scrum teams, sprint planning and backlog planning meetings. 

Excellent communication skills, an effective team player, task leader, skilled in enlisting the support of all team members in aligning with projects and an organization goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain  multi-tier software solutions as well as distributed system using c#, VB.NET , ASP.NET, Web services, ASP.NET Web API , MVC in .NET Framework 3.0/3.5/4.0 using Tortoise SVN and TFS (Team Foundation Server) for version control.
•	Actively involves in enhancements involves changes on Front-End , Business Logic and Data access Layer using different development tools like Visual Studio 2010/2013/2015 and for database SQL server 2008 R2/2013.
•	Actively working on Performance tuning process database level by modifying stored procedure, Function, triggers… Etc. 
•	Working closely with Project Manager and Product Owner in defining and understanding new requirements pertaining to project and also as a part of application architecture process during sprint Planning, grooming meeting.
•	Developing new functionalities as per Client’s requirement in “Strata Eleven” web application involving change at front-end, back-end and database level.
•	Develop and maintain Wrapper web service endpoints between “Strata SBMS” and “Strata Eleven” for Order Transfer Process.
•	Integral Part of developing Single Sign-On wrapper application using SAML integration for External customer to access Eleven system from their personal media buying portal.
•	Integral part of an integration team in different module of “Strata SBMS” distributed Media Buying system.
•	Engaged in inter-departmental activities ensuring timely completion of project and within company constraints.
•	Attend peer-to-peer meeting and meet-ups for Knowledge transfer on various technologies and languages.
•	Actively involved in all phases of Agile Software Development life cycle and participate in daily Stand-up meetings.
•	Monitor day-to-day operational issues as well as escalated issues of more complex nature. Regular reports preparation and submission to the Lead Project Manager regarding project implementation status and identification of any risks or roadblocks.

positions.title: Technical Consultant - II
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and maintaining multi-tier software solutions using ASP.NET, C#.NET, J WCF Services, Microsoft Enterprise Application Blocks in .NET Framework 4.0/4.5 using Tortoise SVN and TFS (Team Foundation Server) for version control.

Integral part in performance tuning application using various techniques like IIS compression, reducing web service call wherever possible by caching data, reducing database lookups by caching data on application servers.

Actively involved in requirement gathering, all phases of Agile Software Development life cycle and participated in daily Stand-up meetings.

Responsible to understand requirements given by clients, architect complete solution in a best possible way, develop, configure, test and deploy custom solution according to requirements.

Point of contact with customers on resolving various issues and creating training manuals to provide post live project support. 

Support migration process for new clients, develop migration tool to parse JSON API response and insert of update data in the Content Direct Invision system via JSON API calls.

Responsible for testing different scenarios of API wsdl in SOAP UI, JSON APIs and certify them for customer’s endpoint.

Responsible for taking utmost care and attention to customer engagement during client visits to client location to educate and answer client’s outstanding questions about CSG products.

Monitor day-to-day operational issues as well as issues of more complex scope. Reports to the Lead Project Manager regarding project implementation status and identification of any risks or roadblocks. 

Engaged in interdepartmental activities ensuring completion of project on schedule (and within budget constraints).

Attend peer to peer meeting and meet-ups for Knowledge transfer on various technologies and languages.

positions.title: System Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and maintaining multi-tier software solutions using ASP.NET, C#.NET, JQuery, WCF Services, Microsoft Enterprise Application Blocks and SQLServer 2008/2012 in .NET Framework 4.0. Used VSS 6.0 and TFS (Team Foundation Server) for version control.

Actively participated in requirement gathering and analysis phase. Actively engaged into all phases of Agile Software Development life cycle and participated in daily Scrum meetings.

Implemented online payment processing gateway SnapPay using .net technologies, .Net Entity Framework, SQLstored procedures, triggers, views, functions which provides complete and affordable solution to the company’s payment processing requirements. Implemented various features and functionalities in payment processing gateway such as credit card authorization, credit card and electronic payment processing by integrating it with multiple payments processing gateway like Verisign, Paypal, Chase, Bluepay, Monaris, 3Delta system etc…

Actively participated in performance tuning application using various techniques like IIS compression, Javascript bundling and minifications, reducing web service call wherever possible by caching data, reducing database lookups by caching data on application servers.

Implemented WCF Service to be used at Application Layer using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), which is tightly integrated with JDEdwards Enterprise One solution and Snap Pay payment processing gateway.

Actively participated in generating ERP2Web CDI e-commerce solution that transforms JD Edwards ERP system to real time B2B (Business to Business) and B2C (Business to Customer) electronic storefront solution over the web.

positions.title: Assistant Software Enigneer (SAP Consultant)
positions.description:
Client: Ashok Layland						            

•	Served as a SAP-ABAP CRM Technical consultant.

•	Developed CRM WEB UI application using SAP technologies like SAP-CRM and ABAP.

•	Played active role in requirement gathering meeting with clients.

•	Designed various modules to enhance existing functionality for code reusability and efficiency.

•	Awarded as an “Employee of the Quarter”.

•	Resolved the Issues reported by functional team according to priorities and if required, provide best fittest solution. 

•	Used JIRA for issue Tracking.

•	Collaborated and presented progress report and presentations to Project Managers as Knowledge Transfer (KT) session.
